questions.question: Which brand archetype does Klear Karma embody to project its role as a grounded and trusted guide?

answerOptions.rationale: While the brand is spiritually literate and knowledgeable, it focuses more on stewardship and reflective strategy than pure wisdom seeking.
This archetype aligns with the brand's mission to provide grounded, reflective guidance and maintain the trust layer between seekers and practitioners.
The brand avoids the 'softness' typically associated with this archetype, opting instead for a serious and disciplined approach to wellness.
Klear Karma intentionally avoids mystical overclaiming and deterministic spiritual authority, which are hallmarks of this archetype.

questions.question: How does Klear Karma define a 'paid-activated user' for its strategic KPI tracking?

answerOptions.text: A user who signs up for the invite-led beta list
answerOptions.rationale: Signup volume is considered a 'vanity metric' compared to the intent shown through token transactions.

answerOptions.text: A user who completes a healer consultation
answerOptions.rationale: While this is a key milestone, activation is defined specifically by the financial commitment to the token economy.

answerOptions.text: A user who recharges at least 299 local currency within 90 days
answerOptions.rationale: Paid activation is measured by a minimum recharge of 299 THB or INR within a three-month window of signup or interaction.

answerOptions.text: A user who spends all 369 free tokens
answerOptions.rationale: Spending free tokens validates utility, but true activation requires the user to transition into a paying customer.

questions.question: Which design principle is a 'hard constraint' for visual assets to avoid the appearance of a generic wellness brand?

answerOptions.text: Use soft pastel colors and chakra rainbows
answerOptions.rationale: The visual guidelines specifically state to avoid 'wellness pastels' and 'chakra rainbows' in favor of a dark, premium palette.

answerOptions.text: No stock faces or generic healer portraits
answerOptions.rationale: Art direction requires app-native spatial compositions and specifically forbids stock photography of faces or gurus.

answerOptions.text: Include physical product packaging and crystal photos
answerOptions.rationale: The brand is app-native only; guardrails prohibit creating images of bottles, kits, or crystals as products.

answerOptions.text: Emphasize crowdfunding and backer reward tiers
answerOptions.rationale: The brand thesis rejects the Kickstarter/crowdfunding aesthetic in favor of a serious investor-ready narrative.
